LGBTQ+ group rides

47 rides in 17 states and 3 more countries · newest check Nov 9, 2026

Rides made by and for queer riders. Some are clubs with decades behind them. Some are a few friends and a taco stop. All of them want you there.

About these 47 rides

There’s a ride every day of the week; Sunday has the most, with 12. The earliest start is WTFNB Weekly with Brevay at 6:30 am; the latest is Ohtli Chiquxs rides at 8:00 pm. After work, 20 roll on a weekday evening. The group waits for everyone on 26 of them (no-drop), and beginners are welcome on 21. There are 17 rides made for women, trans and femme riders and 7 for BIPOC riders. Each one was checked at its source between Sep 15 and Nov 9, 2026.

I’d like to say I ride for everyone else. I ride because it changed me.

In 2027 I ride 10,000 miles, all on the bike, and every ride gets written down. The money goes through the orgs’ own rides. It never touches me.
